findings.claim: PRE-EXISTING RED ROOT CAUSE: the current committed suite_baseline.json was 'promoted' 2026-07-26 but kept top-level passed/failed/skipped scalars for flat-reader backward-compat (Q2-F6). parse_tuple_baseline rejects ANY file with a top-level 'passed'/'failed' key (checks.py:2283), so the file read as FLAT and the guardrail stayed red. Fix = remove those three scalars (the banked proposal).

Removing the top-level scalars regresses NO live reader. check_suite_baseline reads only the gate/shipping legs; bom_audit.py checks only for a UTF-8 BOM; harness/statusline.py never references suite_baseline.json; the guardrails.checks list is name-only. The sole top-level-scalar reader is harness/state/leg0_baselines.json:105's frozen drop-week evidence_command (already stale at 4118/0/87; deny-listed harness/state/**, not a live check).

BLOCKER: harness/verify/suite_baseline.json is deny-listed from agent edit in every profile (agent-settings.json:34, relay-settings.json:61); readonly-settings denies all. W5-BASE's manifest has settings:null, so orchestrate.ps1 (line 236-238) applied no edit-granting profile. The mission's touches/readonly:false cannot be honored by an agent. Design intent is human-only (parse_tuple_baseline error + checks.py:2248). Did NOT circumvent via a bash side-channel.

SECOND, INDEPENDENT pre-existing red: tests/test_statusline.py reddens 4 cases (test_branch_read_without_git_matches_git, test_registry_matches_git_worktree_list, test_head_sha_matches_git, test_suite_figure_from_another_commit_is_not_shown_as_fresh) in ANY linked-worktree run. Root cause: statusline.py:100/127 open ROOT/.git/HEAD directly, but in a worktree .git is a FILE (gitdir redirection) -> head_sha()='' , branch()='?'. Proven worktree-only: main-checkout pytest tests/test_statusline.py = 13 passed. Consequence: even after the shape fix, a WORKTREE-context checks.py --task R.R stays red on the suite_baseline ratchet (failed_now=4). This is NOT part of the data-shape promotion.
